text.en: Sakiko Togawa is the keyboardist of Ave Mujica. She lodges aboard Rhodes Island together with the rest of the band, and actively takes on tasks of all manner aboard the ship. Her musical training and dignified manner are incontrovertible proof of her excellent upbringing.
text.zh: Ave Mujica的键盘手丰川祥子。与其他成员一起暂居罗德岛，在此期间，积极参与舰上的各项工作。不管是音乐上的造诣，还是行为礼仪，都彰显了她不折不扣的名门大小姐身份。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Sakiko Togawa shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
丰川祥子没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】未公开
根据医疗部决议，不公开相关数据。

text.en: We took in the five members of Ave Mujica at Iris's request, her wish being that we provide them temporary refuge. Given their youth and how they were stranded somewhere unfamiliar so far from home, we communicated our intent that they get some much-needed rest. However, all of them expressed that they would rather help us in exchange for their room and board, and Sakiko in particular made clear her strong desire to undertake any and all work here.
text.zh: 经过爱丽丝小姐的担保，我们接纳了包括丰川祥子在内的Ave Mujica的五名成员。爱丽丝告诉我们，希望罗德岛能为这群孩子提供暂且居住的场所。考虑到她们远离故乡且年纪不大，我们想要让Mujica的孩子们好好休息，但是她们每个人都不愿意白白留宿。特别是祥子，她很强硬地表达了希望得到一些舰上的工作的要求，无论是怎样的工作。

text.en: Sakiko is an active participant in a variety of work aboard the landship. Normally dignified and elegant, she shows no qualms about taking up simple communications assignments or manual labor tasks such as cleaning and transporting items; she carries out all her jobs without complaint. It is as though she already had a fair amount of experience with such work before coming to Rhodes Island. During work, she is always sunny and positive, while also showing care and concern for those around her. Her kind smile has left a deep impression on many operators.
text.zh: 祥子在舰上工作得十分积极。举手投足都十足优雅的她，却出乎意料地一直参与着各种基础工作。无论是简单的信息传达，还是保洁、搬运等体力劳动，她从来没有抱怨过苦和累，仿佛在来到罗德岛前她就已经习惯了这样繁重的工作。在她完成这些工作的时候，还总能带着乐观开朗的态度面对身边的人。祥子总会关心身边的干员的状况，为他人担忧，她关切的笑容给很多干员留下了深刻的印象。

text.en:
Sakiko came to Rhodes Island from the Castle of Dreams, and is almost never seen without the other members of Ave Mujica. The five of them, each thinking in different ways and pursuing different things, have been able to come together as a single band and work towards the same goal because of Sakiko.
Sakiko makes mistakes too, of course, but her strength is the ability to make decisions without fear. There would be no Ave Mujica without Sakiko's gentle strength.
text.zh:
从梦城堡来到罗德岛的祥子，总是跟Mujica的大家一同活动。她们虽是一个整体，但是每个人都有着自己的想法，追求着不同的东西。明明性格迥异，但却能紧密合作，而这都是因为祥子。
祥子当然也会失误，但是她总能勇于做出决定。祥子柔和而又坚定，正是有如此的她，才有如此的Ave Mujica。

text.en:
From the information we have, Sakiko was brought up in high society and received an excellent education from a young age, growing into a kind and affable young lady as a result. She formed her own band in emulation of a group of senior students who left a deep impression on her. Then misfortune struck; her father was forced to take the blame and resign after his company fell victim to fraud, and Sakiko was forced to quit her beloved band and work part-time odd jobs to support her broken household thereafter.
Strong-minded and refusing to give up, Sakiko would not let others see her weakness, and formed Ave Mujica in order to cut ties with her past. In spite of this, the new band was not as smooth a venture as Sakiko envisioned, and conflict arose between an inflexible Sakiko and the other band members, who would not open themselves up to her. Through all the turmoil, however, Sakiko was surely the one most mired in suffering, squarely blaming herself and proceeding to repeat her past mistakes.
All that said, Sakiko has seemed somewhat changed from that in her time aboard Rhodes Island. One wonders if she owes it to her experiences at the Castle of Dreams.
text.zh:
据我们的粗浅了解，祥子出身名门，自幼接受的教育塑造了她友爱关怀的一面。这样的祥子因为憧憬学校里的前辈而组建了自己的乐队。后来她的家中遭遇了变故，父亲因为公司遭到诈骗而引咎辞职，一蹶不振。祥子不得不退出了自己喜欢的乐队，通过一份一份的零工来维持自己破碎的家庭。
但祥子是个不愿意服输和妥协的人，她不希望在别人面前展露软弱的一面。要强的她彻底告别了过去，组建起了新的乐队Ave Mujica。然而Ave Mujica的发展也不如祥子所愿，也有大家无法打开心扉的时候。祥子的坚持引发了大家的重大争执，造成了成员的不和，但她同时也是那个最痛苦的人。她也会自责，也会迷茫，也会因为害怕而一次一次犯错。
如今在罗德岛的她似乎有了一些变化，大概是在梦城堡里经历了什么特别的事情吧。

text.en:
[Iris's Notes]
Sakiko is kind-hearted and forward-facing, cares deeply for her friends, and takes it upon herself to grapple with whatever faces her. As a result, however, she has a tendency to lose sight of what is happening around her, and in so doing, hurt her friends unawares.
Sakiko's conviction in her own decisions is firm. In her mind, she must bear the weight of the other members' lives on her shoulders, and running from this responsibility is not an option.
This is something far, far harder than she imagines it might be.
She can still be immature in places; she can still be weak and fearful, anxious that her decisions might hurt others. Moreover, she still harbors doubts that she truly can shoulder her bandmates' lives.
In the Castle of Dreams, Sakiko finally learned to believe in her own ability to fulfill her promises, but one must eventually wake up no matter how sweet the dream; she must come face to face with reality.
Sakiko will not remember what transpired here when she wakes from the dream and goes back to her old life. But I believe that a part of her experiences in the dream will stay with her and give her courage—
The courage for her to overcome all challenges, and continue to carry Ave Mujica atop her shoulders.
text.zh:
【爱丽丝记录】
祥子是一个主动，温柔，积极，很重视身边同伴的人，同时也是个总会一根筋向前，以至于不小心伤害身边同伴的人。祥子的开朗总会吸引身边的人一起跟随她，却也可能因此让她容易忽视他人感受。
祥子总是相信自己的决定。她觉得自己必须肩负身边的人的一生，她从不会逃避这样的责任。
但是做到这一点远比她想象中困难。
她也会不成熟，会害怕，害怕自己的选择会给他人带来痛苦。她也会质疑自己，是否配得上同伴们的一生。
在梦城堡的梦里，祥子最终还是相信自己可以践行自己的承诺。不管梦有多美好，她都要醒来去面对她真正的生活。
当祥子真正从梦中醒来，她不会记得这里发生的一切。但是我们丝毫不会怀疑，祥子在梦里的这些经历会留在她的潜意识里，给予她勇气——
让她勇敢面对自己、相信自己能肩负Ave Mujica走下去的勇气。
